scripts.build: npm run build -w @ares-slicer/wasm && npm run build -w @ares-slicer/profiles && npm run build -w ares-app
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ares-slicer/wasm && npm run build -w @ares-slicer/profiles && npm run dev -w ares-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ares-slicer/wasm && npm run typecheck -w ares-app && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build --release -p ares-cli && cargo nextest run -p ares-wasm --test compatible_presets --test decoded_settings && cargo build --release -p ares-core --example print_config_def && npm run build:wasm && npm run build && playwright test
